verdict.rationale: Skyfire's token architecture inherently attributes each transaction to a specific agent — tokens are scoped to a single agent, kya tokens carry verified identity through checkout, and charges are tied to buyer-issued tokens with wallet balances tracked per agent, so orders are technically traceable to an originating agent. But the evidence never describes merchant-facing reporting/filtering tools, transaction dashboards, or analytics that let a merchant query/report by agent — only API-level token/charge/wallet primitives. Missing for 10: documented merchant reporting UI or API to list/filter historical transactions by agent, aggregate reporting or analytics dashboard for sellers.
